spec.note: Pete 2026-11-07: helmet design example 'bubble' for the robot outfit's hat slot.
spec.outfit: a clear glass dome helmet, like a 1950s space-age fishbowl, enclosing the goose's whole head, with a polished chrome ring at its base around the top of the neck and a short chrome antenna with a blue light on top; the goose's head, eyes and beak are fully visible through the glass; worn with a sleek modern robot suit: a polished chrome and white enamel chest plate with a round glowing blue core in the middle; a thin chrome collar ring around the base of the neck with a small antenna at the back; segmented chrome shoulder caps; white upper-arm and forearm plates; chrome mechanical mitten gauntlets with visible knuckle joints; a black flexible waist section; white thigh plates and chrome knee caps; white shin guards; heavy chrome robot boots; thin glowing blue light strips along the edges of the plates
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real materials. Keep the whole robot suit exactly as it is in picture 1; the only change is the helmet on the goose's head. The helmet fits the goose's own head shape and sits on top of the long black neck, which stays visible down to the chrome collar ring. The goose has NO tail.

view_hint.front: Keep the arms and legs exactly where they are in picture 1.
view_hint.left: Side profile: show the helmet's full shape from the side. Keep the feet and legs exactly where they are in picture 1.
